description: mscf-pipeline guard: denies holdout dates in discovery commands, force pushes, printing secrets, committing working data and editing the ledger; warns on holdout dates in code; reports the ledger count after experiment scripts; optionally denies configured paths and non-no-reply pushes (see hooks/guard.py)

hooks.command: if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/guard.py"; elif command -v python >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/guard.py"; else echo 'mscf-pipeline guard: neither python3 nor python is on PATH; denied' >&2; exit 2; fi
